summary: A planning/design segment reviewing the current workspace, extension, and profile implementation across the Svelte client, protocol, and server. The assistant documented what exists today, then proposed a v2 configuration model that separates installed extensions, workspace-level enablement, canonical defaults, temporary overrides, and custom profiles, alongside concrete protocol, server, store, and UI changes plus test expectations. No files were modified; only reads and analysis were performed.
decisions: Workspace enablement should be modeled as a workspace-level allowlist of extensions with roots, separate from profiles.
